name: gate_evidence_validation
command: import json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('results/phase3'); names=['gate_a_report.json','gate_b_report.json','gate_c_report.json','checkpoint_roundtrip.json']; rows={n:json.loads((p/n).read_text())['status'] for n in names}; print(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)); raise SystemExit(0 if all(v=='PASS' for v in rows.values()) else 1)
